data.name: Nikitha
data.gender_notes: Nikitha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nikitha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'niki' which means victory. This name is often given to a girl born into a warrior or royal family in Hindu tradition, symbolizing her destiny to win battles and rule her kingdom with courage and wisdom. The name Nikitha carries the meaning “Victorious in battle” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nikitha usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious in battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nikitha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious in battle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nikitha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
